name: duopore-public-document-revision-diff
description: See which document sections were added, removed or changed between two drafts.
keywords: see what changed in a draft

interface.shortDescription: See what changed in a draft
interface.longDescription: See which document sections were added, removed or changed between two drafts. Give each section the same ID in both versions, then paste its text. Get the old and new text for changed sections, plus a list of additions and removals. It checks exact text only. It does not compare page design or explain a change's legal effect.
capabilities: See what changed in a draft
defaultPrompt: Compare these document drafts and show changed sections.
Which sections were added or removed in the new draft?

positive.prompt: Use Document Revision Diff with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"before":[{"sectionId":"01","content":"Delivery in 7 days."},{"sectionId":"02","content":"Old note."}],"after":[{"sectionId":"01","content":"Delivery in 10 days."},{"sectionId":"03","content":"New note."}]}
